title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
summary: 3D arena fighter with a huge Dragon Ball roster.

moments.label: Gathering the Dragon Balls
moments.detail: Goku and friends discuss the power of the Dragon Balls.

moments.label: Raditz Arrives
moments.detail: Raditz confronts Goku and reveals Goku's true Saiyan heritage.

moments.label: Goku vs. Raditz
moments.detail: Goku and Piccolo team up to fight Raditz in a desperate battle.

moments.label: Great Ape Vegeta
moments.detail: Vegeta transforms into a Great Ape to crush the Earth's defenders.

moments.label: Super Saiyan Goku
moments.detail: Goku awakens the legendary Super Saiyan form against Frieza.

moments.label: Trunks Arrives
moments.detail: A mysterious youth with a sword appears on Earth.

moments.label: Goku vs. Androids
moments.detail: The battle against the Androids begins as new threats emerge.

moments.label: Super Vegeta's Power
moments.detail: Vegeta shows off his royal strength and new power.

moments.label: Vegeta vs. Cell
moments.detail: Vegeta confronts Semi-Perfect Cell to test his new strength.

moments.label: Cell Reaches Perfection
moments.detail: Cell achieves his final, perfect form despite Vegeta's warnings.

moments.label: Majin Vegeta Emerges
moments.detail: Vegeta succumbs to Babidi's magic and becomes Majin Vegeta.

moments.label: Super Vegito Fights Buu
moments.detail: Goku and Vegeta use potara earrings to fuse into Super Vegito.

moments.label: Spirit Bomb vs. Buu
moments.detail: Goku gathers energy from the universe to defeat Majin Buu.

moments.label: Goku vs. Raditz
moments.detail: Goku faces his brother Raditz with Piccolo's help.

moments.label: Ginyu Body Change
moments.detail: Captain Ginyu swaps bodies with Goku during the fight.

moments.label: Goku vs. Frieza
moments.detail: Goku battles Frieza on Namek, powering up to Super Saiyan.

moments.label: Frieza's 100% Power
moments.detail: Frieza reaches his maximum 100% full power against Goku.

moments.label: Goku vs. Android 19
moments.detail: Goku fights Android 19 before falling ill to his heart condition.

moments.label: Android 16 Joins the Fight
moments.detail: Android 16 steps up to fight Cell to protect Android 17.

moments.label: Goku vs. Androids
moments.detail: Goku spars and tests his skills against the Androids.

moments.label: Goku vs. Android 16
moments.detail: Goku faces off against a fierce Android 16 in battle.

moments.label: Gohan vs. Perfect Cell
moments.detail: Gohan steps up to fight Perfect Cell in the Cell Games.

moments.label: Cell Juniors Attack
moments.detail: The Cell Juniors unleash chaos on the Z Fighters.

moments.label: Goku's Sacrifice
moments.detail: Goku sacrifices himself by teleporting Self-Destructing Cell away.

moments.label: Majin Vegeta vs. Goku
moments.detail: Majin Vegeta battles Goku in an intense grudge match.

moments.label: Super Saiyan 3 Transformation
moments.detail: Goku unveils the legendary Super Saiyan 3 transformation.

moments.label: Fusion and Conclusion
moments.detail: The story approaches its conclusion with fusion and wrap up.
